office_does: A Snohomish County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, small claims, civil cases up to the district-court limit, and protection orders, and is elected by the voters of the court's electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Jennifer Millett, on the Everett Division bench since January 2026, is the only candidate for the short and full term. Elected by Everett District voters only.

candidates.summary: Everett Division District Court judge since January 2026 and former court commissioner and prosecutor, running unopposed for the short and full term.
highlights: District Court judge, Everett Division, since January 2026; commissioner 2022-2026 [S1]
Former City of Marysville prosecuting attorney and Snohomish County deputy prosecutor [S1]
Says she helped develop alternative court programs in District and Municipal Courts [S1]
